p.challenge: Both curves shift at once. Sort each case by the change that is CERTAIN (the other change is ambiguous).

p.title: Price ceiling on wheat
p.challenge: qD = 100 − 2p, qS = 20 + 2p (p* = ₹20). The government fixes a ceiling BELOW p*. Set the ceiling that creates a shortage of 20 units (to be met by rationing).

p.title: Minimum support price (price floor)
p.challenge: qD = 100 − 2p, qS = 20 + 2p (p* = ₹20). Set a floor ABOVE p* that leaves a surplus of 20 units for the FCI to buy as buffer stock.
